revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, observing an office corridor with glass partitions, doors, practical overhead lights, rubberized safety flooring, and warm practical interior lighting. Moderate side view at moderate camera distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, and enough surrounding context to judge body support. Visible subject is an adult with a curvy build wearing a burgundy coat over black and teal clothing with straight-leg trousers, sitting on one bent leg with the other leg extended, hips low but torso clearly non-horizontal. Composition should look like a plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, practical clutter kept behind the subject, no foreground obstruction. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, non-cinematic, non-advertising look. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or artificial annotation.
